nodes.asset_description: A minimalist fashion moodboard collage features streetwear staples—hoodies, long coats, wide‑leg jeans, ribbed crop tops, sneakers, loafers, bucket hats, and sunglasses—arranged on a light gray background. The palette is neutral and muted (black, charcoal, gray, olive, beige) with fabric swatches, doodles, and arrows highlighting select items for a clean, modern composition.
